description: This PHP file defines the 'Product' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for handling product detail page requests. It loads necessary models, fetches product data, manages breadcrumbs, images, prices, options, and related information, and renders the product view with consolidated product details.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Controller class for product detail page in OpenCart, extending the core Controller system to manage product data display.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method handling the display of product details, including loading models, gathering product info, constructing breadcrumbs, preparing images, prices, options, and rendering the view template.
